### 🟡 Changes recommended Both examples can crash with StopIteration if the token limit is reached before a text block is produced, so they need explicit handling for responses without text.
1 open issue - [Handle token-limit stops with no text block](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python-genai/pull/1019#discussion_r4425372622) · New
What changed in this PR Updates the Anthropic instrumentation’s documentation and runnable examples to replace the retired model and accommodate responses that begin with thinking blocks. **Changes:** - Replaces `claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022` with `claude-sonnet-5-5` in four usage examples. - Changes both runnable examples to print the first text block. - Leaves instrumentation behavior, tests, and recorded cassettes unchanged; API execution remains unverified. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `instrumentation/​opentelemetry-instrumentation-genai-anthropic/​src/​opentelemetry/​instrumentation/​genai/​anthropic/​__init__.py` | Updates the model in the package docstring example. | | `instrumentation/​opentelemetry-instrumentation-genai-anthropic/​README.rst` | Updates the model in the documented usage example. | | `instrumentation/​opentelemetry-instrumentation-genai-anthropic/​examples/​zero-code/​main.py` | Updates the model and selects the first text block. | | `instrumentation/​opentelemetry-instrumentation-genai-anthropic/​examples/​manual/​main.py` | Updates the model and selects the first text block. |
Review effort: Balanced
Can you please add a change log? Thanks for your contribution.

review_comments.body: If generation reaches the 1,024-token limit during thinking before producing a text block, `next()` raises `StopIteration` and the example exits with a traceback. Provide a default or an explicit no-text branch that reports the stop reason. Apply the same handling in `examples/zero-code/main.py:17`.
